description: This file defines the ScrollEffect class, a custom effect for handling scrolling behavior in Kivy applications, including bounds checking, overscroll handling, and interaction management.

classes.name: ScrollEffect
classes.description: A custom Kivy effect that manages scroll behavior with bounds, overscroll, and displacement tracking.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the effect's value and velocity to a specified position, clearing history.

methods.name: on_value
methods.description: Handles updates when the effect's value changes, managing overscroll and bounds.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the scroll effect, marking it as manual and resetting displacement.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the displacement based on movement during interaction.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Ends the scroll interaction, determining if velocity should be reset based on displacement.
